I believe that it’s not the company, but the staff working in an organisation, that can either break a company or take it to new heights.

I have dealt with” Blue Star Air Travel Services (I) P. Ltd “, at Elphinstone ( West), Near India Bulls, in the past, several times in fact, with no issues , however this time it was quite different.

This time I dealt with a person by the name of Ms. Renuka Nair ( mobile # xx19666671 ) and I found her to be vindictive and very curt.

I needed some euros for my trip to Spain and specifically asked her for the Euros to be given to me in 50’ s and 20's only, she confirmed that she had the denomination that I requested and so I went ahead with the deal.

The next day she sent the Euros in all Bill’s hundred. There were no 50s or 20s as she had confirmed just one day prior, not one.

At  first I  did not accept it, but after she confirmed that she would change them the very next day, I took her word for it, and went ahead with the deal.

The next day I called her and she said that it would take a few days to make the exchange. I always plan in advance, and so had 3 months before my travel date, and so did not have a problem with her request.

I called her after a week and she said that it would still take a couple more days. After a few days I called her again and she told  me that the denomination I requested would be available in a few days  and she asked me not to worry about it... but that day never came.

After that I WhatsApped her at least 6 times and called her at least 4 more, but she always made excuses. Now I am back from my trip, and i did have a hard time exchanging the 100 euros , just as I predicted, and so decided to write this review.

Vindictive and curt people like Renuka Nair, should always be monitored by their superiors, else it spoils the name and reputation of the entire company.

They should constantly be watched over and should report to their superiors everyday as they mismanage operations and provide false information to clients.
I hope that this review is read by her supervisor and that she is pulled up for this issue , so that this kind of thing is not repeated in future.
